name: Mortadella
siboNotes: Plain mortadella is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it contains no FODMAPs. Check labels for garlic powder or onion powder which would make it unsuitable.
preparationTips: Read ingredients carefully - some brands contain garlic or onion powder
Choose high-quality mortadella with minimal additives
Slice thinly for sandwiches or cube for salads
Store properly refrigerated and consume within use-by date
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of iron and zinc
